headline: UK Interest Rates Expected to Rise for First Time in Over Three Years
summary: Most analysts are predicting an interest rate increase from 3.75% to 4%, marking the first increase in more than three years.
why: Central bank interest rate changes are a primary tool for managing monetary policy, influencing borrowing costs, inflation, and currency valuations across the economy.

impacts.name: United Kingdom
impacts.why: An expected interest rate increase directly raises the country's benchmark borrowing costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Expectations of higher interest rates typically strengthen the domestic currency and increase yields on short-term government debt as borrowing costs rise.
